summary: The Ramp Entry dressup now measures its Angle property from the horizontal plane (matching Helix and Adaptive) instead of the vertical, with a hidden RampVertical property added so restored documents keep the old interpretation.

pages.reason: Path/Dressup/Gui/RampEntry.py: execute() now passes angle_rad directly unless obj.RampVertical, so Angle (default 60) is measured from horizontal for new dressups; hidden RampVertical bool added (True on restored docs, False on new ones)
